name: Skill / Competency Definition
purpose: Represent scheme-scoped Skill and Competency definitions, immutable scheme releases, composition and explicitly lossy mappings without owning person capability assertions, assessments, qualifications, credentials or role assignments.

owns: language-tagged labels, definition text, definition type and applicability
intra-scheme definition structure and deprecation/successor lineage
version-pinned directional concept mappings with purpose, authority and declared semantic loss
delegates: proficiency scale identity and level semantics to an identifier-unassigned Proficiency Scale candidate
person capability holdings to an identifier-unassigned Person Capability Assertion candidate
qualification definitions and awards to WM-PER-008
issued credential identity and validity to WM-XCT-017
position expectations and requirements to WM-ORG-004
excludes: proficiency scale level ownership or level mappings
current competence flag or merged current score

relations.purpose: Position expectations pin definitions and scale versions.
Qualification definitions and awards remain external.
Pre-allocation review handle only; rewritten after allocation.
Pre-allocation review handle only; rewritten after allocation.
Party/authority master; pinned source remains held.

invariants: Concept lineage is schemeId plus conceptId; a pinned address adds releaseId, and conceptType cannot change within a lineage.
Issued scheme releases are immutable and content-digest verified; version is a non-identifying label.
Preferred and alternative labels carry BCP-47 tags and only one preferred label exists per tag.
Definition objects never own a person, level, evidence, assessment, qualification, credential, licence, role or course state.
Composition components are version-pinned and typed as knowledge, skill or behavior definitions.
Authority evidence at definition scope never references a person assertion or assessment result.
Deprecated, retired, superseded and withdrawn objects remain resolvable with lineage and times.
Concept mappings pin endpoint releases; endpoints resolve inside those releases and self-mapping is forbidden.
Concept mappings are directional, non-transitive and non-reversible without an independent reverse mapping.
Equivalent-for-declared-purpose never permits identity merge, deduplication or substitution outside the stated purpose.
semanticLoss always has a non-empty residualDescription; no none or lossless shortcut is allowed.
Mapping authority never implies target-scheme endorsement; endorsement is explicit.
recordedAt and validFrom/validTo remain distinct on every governed object; observedAt is optional and never substitutes for either.
Human definitions never share identity with AI-agent instruction packages.
Completing reserved WM-PER-009 allocates no additional identifier and pre-allocation slugs carry no registry claim.
holds: The WM-PER-009 registered name, entry kind, purpose and boundary are proposed reconstructions pending reserved-row confirmation.
Agreement between providers is not verification; no invariant or fixture has been executed, domain-approved or registry-approved.
No approved competency relation rows are available; all relations and delegate handles remain held.
External standards and named releases require pinned sources; fixtures use placeholders until then.
Person, party and course/learning ownership require pinned mastering-model confirmation.
All bases remain reviewable drafts or carry inherited holds; package conversion and live verification remain pending.
registeredMetadataState: proposed reconstruction; reserved registry record must be confirmed

referenceGrammar.model: catalogue model or pre-allocation review slug
referenceGrammar.digest: optional fixity pin; required where source policy demands it
